reconstruction_equivalence_hypothesis.description: Theorem hypotheses derived from formalized reconstruction equivalence geometry.

hypotheses.statement: Theorem remains well-posed when preimages are restricted to manifold_fiber_family (RPF-003) equivalence classes.
Admissible stability holds for the entire same_delta_branch_family (REC-EQ-004) set.
Asymptotic stabilization results apply to equivalence basins (REB-001) rather than unique state vectors.
